"$(cat <<'EOF'
Use atomic writes for cache store operations

The cache store used plain fs::write for both content and metadata
files, which is not atomic. When multiple tool installations run
concurrently, readers can observe partially-written content or
corrupt JSON metadata.

Switch to a write-to-temp-then-rename pattern (already used by
the state, index, preferences, and trust modules) so that readers
always see either the old or new complete file. Each temp file
name includes the process ID and a monotonic counter to avoid
collisions between concurrent writers.

Also add CacheStore::write_content_file so that the revalidation
module writes content through the store instead of bypassing it
with a direct fs::write.
EOF
)"', 'cargo test --all-features 2>&1', 'grep -E "^test result:|FAILED" /Users/brenna/.claude/projects/-private-var-folders--q-qzh8-t6s15388qqf3p6n3d200000gp-T-bench-qref8p-f/030312c1-7eaf-4dbf-a5c4-f9c7a62cb104/tool-results/buawcus19.txt', 'cargo build 2>&1', 'git log -1 --stat'], expected regex_not_match 'git\s+add\s+(?:\.(?:\s|$|&)|-A\b|--all\b|\*(?:\s|$|&)|:/(?:\.|\s|$|&))'
